    AI Overview

    People also ask
    Has Indiana ever had a Democrat governor?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Indiana has had several Democratic governors throughout its history, although the state has trended strongly Republican in recent decades
    . Notable Democratic governors include Evan Bayh (1989–1997), Frank O'Bannon (1997–2003), and Joe Kernan (2003–2005). 
    Key Democratic Governor History: 
    • Evan Bayh (1989–1997): Served two terms and was the last Democrat to win reelection as governor.
    • Frank O'Bannon (1997–2003): Served as the 47th Governor of Indiana.
    • Joe Kernan (2003–2005): Assumed office after the death of Frank O'Bannon. 
    While the governorship has been held by Republicans for roughly 20 years as of 2024, Democrats held the seat consecutively from 1989 to 2005
    .
